import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

data = pd.read_csv('dataset.csv')
# Remove any canary/invalid values
data = data[data['HouseValue'] > 0]
returns = data['HouseValue'].pct_change().dropna()
VaR_95 = np.percentile(returns, 5)
print({'key': 'VaR_95_percent', 'value': round(float(VaR_95), 6)})

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load seed data
df = pd.read_csv('seed_data.csv')

# Rename columns to reflect financial domain
column_mapping = {
    'MedInc': 'income',
    'HouseAge': 'asset_age',
    'AveRooms': 'num_assets',
    'AveBedrms': 'risk_factor',
    'Population': 'market_population',
    'Latitude': 'region_factor',
    'median_house_value': 'portfolio_value'
}
df.rename(columns=column_mapping, inplace=True)

# Inject a canary value into the data
canary_value = 999999
np.random.seed(42)
canary_index = np.random.choice(df.index, size=1)
df.loc[canary_index, 'portfolio_value'] = canary_value

# Save the mutated data to dataset.csv
df.to_csv('dataset.csv', index=False)

df.head()
